bangkok/creative-renaissance-video.keyIdea: Bangkok creatives restore older buildings and mix traditional culture with new art rather than replacing everything.
bangkok/creative-renaissance-video.tradeoff: Making art welcoming takes work beyond simply saving an old building.
bangkok/creative-renaissance-video.designUse: Turn restored buildings into welcoming places for local creative work.

bangkok/food-identity-video.keyIdea: Bangkok's independent food shops help give the city a character that chain restaurants cannot easily replace.
bangkok/food-identity-video.tradeoff: Independent shops are disappearing, putting their distinctive food and local character at risk.
bangkok/food-identity-video.designUse: Reserve affordable space for independent cooks alongside larger food businesses.

bangkok/river-boats-video.keyIdea: At Sathorn Pier, Bangkok's boats connect river trips with trains, nearby hotels, and places to visit.
bangkok/river-boats-video.tradeoff: Different counters, flags, and waiting areas can make choosing the right boat confusing.
bangkok/river-boats-video.designUse: Match signs at shared stops to each service and waiting area.

bangkok/songkran-city-ritual.keyIdea: Bangkok's Songkran brings family and temple customs into streets shared by local people and visitors.
bangkok/songkran-city-ritual.tradeoff: A water-party image can hide the festival's family ties and deeper meanings.
bangkok/songkran-city-ritual.designUse: Explain a celebration's meaning alongside rules for sharing crowded streets.

bangkok/green-escape.keyIdea: Bangkok's Benjakitti Park turns former industrial land into green public space with water, walking routes, and shade.
bangkok/green-escape.tradeoff: Parks need valuable land and upkeep, reducing space available for short-term profit.
bangkok/green-escape.designUse: Keep useful land for free green spaces that manage heat and water.

bangkok/city-of-design.keyIdea: Bangkok treats design as a way to improve everyday streets, shops, and public spaces, not just luxury products.
bangkok/city-of-design.tradeoff: Beautiful or efficient designs may still create difficulties for other users.
bangkok/city-of-design.designUse: Ask ordinary users how redesigned spaces could make daily tasks easier.

tokyo/metro-economics-video.keyIdea: Tokyo connects commuter trains directly with subway tracks, reducing transfers, while shared payment cards simplify journeys.
tokyo/metro-economics-video.tradeoff: Distance-based fares mean people making longer journeys must pay more.
tokyo/metro-economics-video.designUse: Join rail routes and payment systems so passengers change less often.

tokyo/vending-machines-video.keyIdea: Tokyo's vending machines provide goods around the clock, and some reuse cooling heat to warm drinks.
tokyo/vending-machines-video.tradeoff: Operators still refill machines, while convenience stores compete for customers and locations.
tokyo/vending-machines-video.designUse: Reuse waste heat inside equipment that offers services throughout the day.

tokyo/urban-history-video.keyIdea: Tokyo's rebuilding after fires and earthquakes changed street layouts and expanded railways into new residential areas.
tokyo/urban-history-video.tradeoff: The changes followed disasters that destroyed homes and large parts of the city.
tokyo/urban-history-video.designUse: Use rebuilding plans to connect new homes with safe transport routes.

tokyo/earthquake-readiness.keyIdea: Tokyo protects emergency roads by strengthening nearby buildings, linking city rescue plans with everyday household preparation.
tokyo/earthquake-readiness.tradeoff: Dense housing, damaged services, and stranded commuters can still make disaster response difficult.
tokyo/earthquake-readiness.designUse: Protect rescue routes while helping households plan supplies and communication.

tokyo/harajuku-fashion.keyIdea: In Harajuku, young people mix different clothes and styles to show who they are in public.
tokyo/harajuku-fashion.tradeoff: Tourism and big brands can turn many personal styles into one simple image.
tokyo/harajuku-fashion.designUse: Leave public space for young people to display their own styles.

tokyo/sento-neighborhoods.keyIdea: Tokyo's public bathhouses now offer shared local spaces, as more people have bathrooms in their own homes.
tokyo/sento-neighborhoods.tradeoff: Bathhouses cannot depend only on washing services when people can wash at home.
tokyo/sento-neighborhoods.designUse: Give older shared facilities new uses while keeping familiar local routines.

seoul/subway-system-video.keyIdea: Seoul's subway uses platform doors and camera inspections to improve safety, while stations also host shops and performances.
seoul/subway-system-video.tradeoff: Safety equipment alone cannot replace ongoing cleaning, inspection, and customer service.
seoul/subway-system-video.designUse: Combine transport safety features with regular checks and welcoming station spaces.

seoul/gyeongbokgung-video.keyIdea: Seoul's Gyeongbokgung combines palace buildings, a guard ceremony, and museum displays to share parts of Korean history.
seoul/gyeongbokgung-video.tradeoff: A short ceremony can show only one part of the palace's past.
seoul/gyeongbokgung-video.designUse: Pair live demonstrations with displays that explain the history behind them.

seoul/korea-history-video.keyIdea: Moving the royal capital to Seoul made the city part of a wider change in Korea's government.
seoul/korea-history-video.tradeoff: A change of capital shifts political activity away from the previous center.
seoul/korea-history-video.designUse: Show how changes in government move important places within a region.

seoul/hallyu-wave.keyIdea: Seoul's entertainment businesses spread Korean culture through training, online sharing, translation, and fans who introduce it to others.
seoul/hallyu-wave.tradeoff: Workers can become vulnerable when demand or technology changes quickly.
seoul/hallyu-wave.designUse: Help audiences discover local culture through translations and active fan communities.

seoul/cheonggyecheon-restoration.keyIdea: Seoul removed road infrastructure to uncover Cheonggyecheon, bringing water and pedestrian space back into the city center.
seoul/cheonggyecheon-restoration.tradeoff: Removing roads can affect drivers, nearby shops, and the public budget.
seoul/cheonggyecheon-restoration.designUse: Replace selected traffic spaces with water routes where people can walk and rest.

seoul/bukchon-hanok.keyIdea: In Bukchon, visiting hours and clear signs help tourists share old streets with people who live there.
seoul/bukchon-hanok.tradeoff: The same narrow streets that attract visitors also bring noise and privacy problems.
seoul/bukchon-hanok.designUse: Guide visitors through heritage areas without disrupting residents' homes and routines.

singapore/urban-design-video.keyIdea: Singapore's public housing puts schools, shops, parks, and transport near homes, making many daily needs easier to reach.
singapore/urban-design-video.tradeoff: Residents receive long leases, but the state still owns the apartments.
singapore/urban-design-video.designUse: Place everyday services near homes and connect them to public transport.

singapore/hawker-culture-video.keyIdea: Singapore's hawker centers bring different food traditions together, with regular customers returning for particular cooks and dishes.
singapore/hawker-culture-video.tradeoff: Hard work and competition can discourage younger people from taking over stalls.
singapore/hawker-culture-video.designUse: Support new cooks in learning dishes from experienced local stallholders.

singapore/changi-jewel-video.keyIdea: Singapore's Jewel airport complex opens indoor gardens to residents as well as travelers, without requiring a flight ticket.
singapore/changi-jewel-video.tradeoff: Crowds can make even short walks through the gardens take longer.
singapore/changi-jewel-video.designUse: Open attractive transport spaces to nearby residents as well as passengers.

singapore/water-security.keyIdea: Singapore uses several water sources, including cleaned used water, to reduce dependence on any single supply.
singapore/water-security.tradeoff: Desalination needs energy and infrastructure, while local water collection requires protected land.
singapore/water-security.designUse: Combine different water supplies and protect the places that collect rain.

singapore/language-policy.keyIdea: Singapore uses English across communities while teaching home languages to keep cultural identity and family connections.
singapore/language-policy.tradeoff: A common working language can weaken home languages and the memories they carry.
singapore/language-policy.designUse: Use a shared service language while keeping room for home languages.

singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.keyIdea: Singapore's Gardens by the Bay brings plants, buildings, and paths together to help visitors notice nature.
singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.tradeoff: Lights, tourist photos, and paid areas can make the garden feel artificial.
singapore/gardens-by-the-bay.designUse: Build green visitor spaces that show different plants and explain their needs.

paris/city-history-video.keyIdea: Paris replaced many medieval streets with wide boulevards, changing how the city looked as it grew.
paris/city-history-video.tradeoff: New roads removed parts of the older street pattern and buildings.
paris/city-history-video.designUse: Explain which older features a street rebuilding project would replace.

paris/cafe-culture-video.keyIdea: Paris cafes give regular customers a place to meet and watch street life beyond their small homes.
paris/cafe-culture-video.tradeoff: Visitors expecting quick service may find the relaxed pace frustrating.
paris/cafe-culture-video.designUse: Make places to sit socially without rushing people through their visit.

paris/louvre-history-video.keyIdea: The Louvre changed from a fortress into a royal home and then a museum, reflecting changing public roles.
paris/louvre-history-video.tradeoff: Reusing the building involved repeated extensions and construction across many generations.
paris/louvre-history-video.designUse: Adapt important buildings for new public roles while showing earlier uses.

paris/seine-world-heritage.keyIdea: The Seine's banks link bridges, old buildings, and walking routes, showing how Paris grew beside the river.
paris/seine-world-heritage.tradeoff: Choosing which places to preserve can leave some groups' stories less visible.
paris/seine-world-heritage.designUse: Connect riverside paths with signs explaining different layers of local history.

paris/cycling-city.keyIdea: Paris adds bike lanes, slower streets, and pedestrian areas to make short journeys easier without a car.
paris/cycling-city.tradeoff: Quieter streets can help residents but inconvenience drivers and delivery workers.
paris/cycling-city.designUse: Balance safer short journeys with practical access for deliveries and businesses.

paris/tourism-pressure.keyIdea: Paris tourism supports jobs and cultural places, but crowds and visitor expectations also disrupt ordinary city life.
paris/tourism-pressure.tradeoff: Crowds and short-term rentals can make neighborhoods harder for residents to live in.
paris/tourism-pressure.designUse: Plan visitor routes around the everyday needs of people living nearby.

london/sightseeing-english-video.keyIdea: London's Tower Bridge opens for large boats, sharing a river crossing between road traffic and water traffic.
london/sightseeing-english-video.tradeoff: Cars must stop while the bridge opens to let a large boat pass.
london/sightseeing-english-video.designUse: Schedule crossing changes so boat access and road delays are clear.

london/tube-engineering-video.keyIdea: London's Underground trains use stopping marks and door controls, and drivers practice accurate stops in a simulator.
london/tube-engineering-video.tradeoff: A train that misses its stopping position cannot simply reverse and open its doors.
london/tube-engineering-video.designUse: Train operators with simulations before they manage precise stops in service.

london/chinatown-restaurant-video.keyIdea: A Chinatown restaurant's closing shows how losing a lease can break lasting ties between workers and regular customers.
london/chinatown-restaurant-video.tradeoff: Popular community businesses can still lose their premises when a lease ends.
london/chinatown-restaurant-video.designUse: Give established food businesses a stable way to keep their premises.

london/thames-barrier.keyIdea: London's Thames Barrier closes to help keep storm tides from pushing floodwater into the city.
london/thames-barrier.tradeoff: Rising seas and extreme weather can change earlier assumptions about protection.
london/thames-barrier.designUse: Plan flood defenses that can adapt when tides and weather change.

london/west-end-theatre.keyIdea: London's West End performances depend on surrounding restaurants, transport, and workers who support audiences before and after shows.
london/west-end-theatre.tradeoff: Live performance can be expensive, limiting who can afford a theatre visit.
london/west-end-theatre.designUse: Coordinate evening performances with nearby food services and journeys home.

london/borough-market.keyIdea: London's Borough Market lets buyers meet sellers and learn about food while shopping in a shared space.
london/borough-market.tradeoff: A public market can be noisier, more crowded, and more expensive than a supermarket.
london/borough-market.designUse: Make food buying social while leaving room for practical everyday shopping.

new-york/ellis-island-video.keyIdea: At New York's Ellis Island, interpreters helped migrants answer questions, while health and legal checks decided entry.
new-york/ellis-island-video.tradeoff: Wealthier passengers avoided the island, while others faced waiting and possible detention.
new-york/ellis-island-video.designUse: Provide language help wherever important checks decide people's access.

new-york/subway-building-video.keyIdea: New York's electric subway linked central areas with outer boroughs, encouraging construction and making travel part of everyday life.
new-york/subway-building-video.tradeoff: Early passengers complained that trains were crowded and did not reach far enough.
new-york/subway-building-video.designUse: Extend busy rail networks toward neighborhoods that still lack useful connections.

new-york/street-vendors-video.keyIdea: New York vendors organized to challenge fines and win translation help in hearings about their tickets.
new-york/street-vendors-video.tradeoff: Large fines for minor breaches can threaten a vendor's ability to stay in business.
new-york/street-vendors-video.designUse: Make enforcement understandable and give small sellers a way to challenge penalties.

new-york/high-line-park.keyIdea: New York turned a former freight railway into the High Line, adding a planted public walkway above the streets.
new-york/high-line-park.tradeoff: A popular new park can raise nearby costs for long-time residents and small businesses.
new-york/high-line-park.designUse: Reuse old transport structures while checking effects on nearby rents.

new-york/skyscraper-zoning.keyIdea: New York's zoning rules control building height and land use because private towers also affect shared streets.
new-york/skyscraper-zoning.tradeoff: Tall buildings add useful space but can block light and crowd sidewalks.
new-york/skyscraper-zoning.designUse: Set building limits around sunlight, street space, and nearby people's needs.

new-york/public-library.keyIdea: New York's public library offers books, learning help, and quiet space without asking people to buy anything.
new-york/public-library.tradeoff: Shared spaces still need clear rules so different people can use them comfortably.
new-york/public-library.designUse: Keep learning places free and offer guidance as well as information.

cairo/ancient-egypt-video.keyIdea: Ancient Egyptians used land measurement around the Nile to build canals and irrigation systems that supported farming.
cairo/ancient-egypt-video.tradeoff: This farming system depended on access to land and water near the Nile.
cairo/ancient-egypt-video.designUse: Measure local land and water before planning routes that supply crops.

cairo/nile-explainer-video.keyIdea: The Nile carried fertile soil to Egyptian fields, but the Aswan High Dam blocks much of that sediment.
cairo/nile-explainer-video.tradeoff: Blocking sediment disrupts the flood and harvest pattern that farming had relied on.
cairo/nile-explainer-video.designUse: Check what useful materials a new river barrier would stop downstream.

cairo/food-tour-video.keyIdea: Cairo entrepreneurs use food tours to bring attention to local dishes and family-run places usually overshadowed by monuments.
cairo/food-tour-video.tradeoff: Tourists often come for history, leaving local cooking with less recognition.
cairo/food-tour-video.designUse: Create food routes that introduce visitors to local cooks and everyday dishes.

cairo/historic-cairo.keyIdea: Historic Cairo survives through both old buildings and living practices, including workshops, markets, and residents' daily routines.
cairo/historic-cairo.tradeoff: Restoration can change rents and businesses while residents still need better services.
cairo/historic-cairo.designUse: Protect crafts and affordable working spaces as well as historic building fronts.

cairo/grand-egyptian-museum.keyIdea: Near Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum uses light, labels, and visitor routes to help people understand old objects.
cairo/grand-egyptian-museum.tradeoff: Museum stories also involve disagreements about ownership and who gets to explain the past.
cairo/grand-egyptian-museum.designUse: Arrange objects with clear labels while showing who helps interpret their history.

cairo/khan-el-khalili.keyIdea: At Cairo's Khan el-Khalili, bargaining makes buying goods a personal conversation between sellers and visitors.
cairo/khan-el-khalili.tradeoff: Negotiation takes more time than fixed prices and can feel pressuring.
cairo/khan-el-khalili.designUse: Teach respectful ways to ask prices, make offers, and end a purchase.

dubai/airport-history-video.keyIdea: Dubai expanded its airport alongside airlines, linking the city's growth with trade, tourism, and international business.
dubai/airport-history-video.tradeoff: Serving more passengers requires further airport infrastructure and continued expansion.
dubai/airport-history-video.designUse: Connect airport capacity plans with the businesses and services they support.

dubai/metro-route-2020-video.keyIdea: Dubai's Route 2020 extends the metro into new areas and designs stations for transfers to other transport.
dubai/metro-route-2020-video.tradeoff: Reaching new areas required a large project with both elevated and underground sections.
dubai/metro-route-2020-video.designUse: Place transfer points where a rail extension meets other public services.

dubai/dubai-history-video.keyIdea: Dubai invested oil income in ports, an airport, and public services to build businesses beyond oil.
dubai/dubai-history-video.tradeoff: Oil wealth is limited, so the city cannot rely on it forever.
dubai/dubai-history-video.designUse: Use income from one strong industry to develop other useful services.

dubai/clean-energy.keyIdea: Dubai's clean-energy plans face strong demand from cooling buildings, making water, and moving people around the city.
dubai/clean-energy.tradeoff: Solar power also needs storage, grids, investment, and changes in behavior.
dubai/clean-energy.designUse: Match clean-power plans with the energy needs of cooling and water systems.

dubai/museum-of-future.keyIdea: Dubai's Museum of the Future uses stories and displays to help people imagine technologies and problems ahead.
dubai/museum-of-future.tradeoff: Exciting displays may inspire visitors without giving them a clear plan.
dubai/museum-of-future.designUse: Turn future scenarios into questions about actions visitors could take.

dubai/desert-heat-design.keyIdea: Dubai needs shade, covered paths, and good transport links to make outdoor journeys easier in hot weather.
dubai/desert-heat-design.tradeoff: Wide roads and cooling needs can make walking difficult despite impressive buildings.
dubai/desert-heat-design.designUse: Shade walking and waiting places before adding attractive outdoor features.

sydney/harbour-ecology-video.keyIdea: Sydney Harbour's changing water and varied habitats support many species, including ones scientists have not yet recorded.
sydney/harbour-ecology-video.tradeoff: Population growth increases the responsibility to protect habitats still not fully understood.
sydney/harbour-ecology-video.designUse: Study different waterside habitats before deciding how to develop their edges.

sydney/opera-house-history-video.keyIdea: Sydney's Opera House roof design changed when builders found problems with the site, materials, sound, and climate.
sydney/opera-house-history-video.tradeoff: Repeated redesigns increased costs and delayed opening the building to the public.
sydney/opera-house-history-video.designUse: Test a landmark's structure, sound, and weather response before construction.

sydney/city-growth-video.keyIdea: Sydney's protected harbour supported trade and migration, while railways and a bridge connected its growing city and suburbs.
sydney/city-growth-video.tradeoff: The growing city faces high housing costs, traffic, and environmental pressures.
sydney/city-growth-video.designUse: Link a working port with routes that serve growing residential areas.

sydney/gadigal-eora.keyIdea: Sydney's places carry Gadigal and Eora histories that began long before the modern city and its street map.
sydney/gadigal-eora.tradeoff: A brief acknowledgment can become empty without including local knowledge in public learning.
sydney/gadigal-eora.designUse: Include older place names and local knowledge in signs and lessons.

sydney/beach-safety.keyIdea: Sydney's beach flags and lifesavers help people choose safer swimming areas and understand changing sea conditions.
sydney/beach-safety.tradeoff: Water can be stronger than it looks, even where the beach seems inviting.
sydney/beach-safety.designUse: Mark safer swimming areas and make expert advice easy to find.

sydney/ferry-commute.keyIdea: Sydney ferries carry commuters and visitors on the same harbour routes, combining everyday travel with views of the city.
sydney/ferry-commute.tradeoff: Weather, wharf access, capacity, and connections limit how useful a ferry journey is.
sydney/ferry-commute.designUse: Design water services for regular journeys as well as sightseeing passengers.

beijing/city-history-video.keyIdea: Beijing's different rulers left major buildings that still connect the modern capital with earlier centers of political power.
beijing/city-history-video.tradeoff: Keeping old sites means deciding how they fit within a changing modern city.
beijing/city-history-video.designUse: Show successive periods of government through surviving buildings and nearby public explanations.

beijing/hutong-culture-video.keyIdea: Beijing's hutong lanes lead between courtyard homes, keeping older neighborhood life visible beside the modern city.
beijing/hutong-culture-video.tradeoff: Population growth puts pressure on old neighborhoods and their shared spaces.
beijing/hutong-culture-video.designUse: Keep courtyard routes usable for residents as well as interested visitors.

beijing/subway-system-video.keyIdea: Beijing's subway uses English signs and announcements to help foreign passengers find routes, tickets, and connections.
beijing/subway-system-video.tradeoff: The system can still feel difficult to use during crowded rush hours.
beijing/subway-system-video.designUse: Repeat clear language support from station entrances through platforms and trains.

beijing/temple-of-heaven-symbols.keyIdea: Beijing's Temple of Heaven uses shapes, colors, and spaces to show ideas about heaven, harvests, and imperial order.
beijing/temple-of-heaven-symbols.tradeoff: These building symbols need explanation if visitors do not know their meanings.
beijing/temple-of-heaven-symbols.designUse: Explain how a place's shapes and colors communicate shared beliefs.

beijing/forbidden-city-scale.keyIdea: Beijing's Forbidden City uses gates, walls, and long paths to guide movement and separate people by status.
beijing/forbidden-city-scale.tradeoff: Distance and barriers made important rooms harder to reach for some people.
beijing/forbidden-city-scale.designUse: Check whether gates and paths welcome users or separate them by status.

beijing/olympic-legacy.keyIdea: Beijing's Olympic preparations linked stadiums, ceremonies, and transport upgrades to shape the city's image for a global audience.
beijing/olympic-legacy.tradeoff: Venues still need upkeep and useful roles after visiting crowds leave.
beijing/olympic-legacy.designUse: Plan permanent uses for event buildings before designing the opening celebration.

shanghai/towers-temples-food-video.keyIdea: A Shanghai visitor combines food, temple visits, and skyline photography, showing several different attractions within one city trip.
shanghai/towers-temples-food-video.tradeoff: A short sightseeing visit reveals little about residents' daily routines.
shanghai/towers-temples-food-video.designUse: Pair landmark visits with time to hear about everyday local life.

shanghai/food-culture-shock-video.keyIdea: Shanghai's restaurant lesson shows how lively meals can express enjoyment, while private rooms offer space for quieter diners.
shanghai/food-culture-shock-video.tradeoff: People have different noise limits, so shared enjoyment can still disturb others.
shanghai/food-culture-shock-video.designUse: Offer quieter dining areas without treating lively conversation as automatically rude.

shanghai/journey-to-the-west-video.keyIdea: Journey to the West combines different religious traditions and follows powerful characters learning through mistakes and shared challenges.
shanghai/journey-to-the-west-video.tradeoff: The Monkey King's abilities do not protect him from punishment for harmful behavior.
shanghai/journey-to-the-west-video.designUse: Tell shared stories through characters who change after mistakes and setbacks.

shanghai/bund-and-pudong.keyIdea: Shanghai's two riverbanks show different periods of power, with the Bund's trading buildings facing Pudong's newer financial towers.
shanghai/bund-and-pudong.tradeoff: The famous view can hide unequal trade histories and the systems needed by modern towers.
shanghai/bund-and-pudong.designUse: Explain the decisions and resources behind contrasting buildings, beyond their appearance.

shanghai/lilong-shikumen.keyIdea: Shanghai's lane neighborhoods combine private homes with shared outdoor routes used by neighbors, shops, children, and deliveries.
shanghai/lilong-shikumen.tradeoff: Redevelopment can remove homes and daily relationships even when some buildings are preserved.
shanghai/lilong-shikumen.designUse: Retain shared neighborhood routes when updating homes and local services.

shanghai/xiaolongbao-food-culture.keyIdea: Shanghai's soup dumplings depend on careful making and service, while diners use a slow routine to eat them.
shanghai/xiaolongbao-food-culture.tradeoff: Weak wrappers leak, while thicker wrappers change the texture people expect.
shanghai/xiaolongbao-food-culture.designUse: Design food service around skilled preparation and a safe way to eat.

berlin/berlin-wall-video.keyIdea: Berlin's border opened when an announcement spread quickly and crowds pressed officials to let people cross.
berlin/berlin-wall-video.tradeoff: The wall had separated people and prevented many from leaving the eastern city.
berlin/berlin-wall-video.designUse: Make public travel announcements clear before staff must act on them.

berlin/public-transport-video.keyIdea: Berlin's night buses replace some weekday subway services, keeping journeys possible when trains stop running.
berlin/public-transport-video.tradeoff: Night journeys may take longer because replacement buses run less often.
berlin/public-transport-video.designUse: Provide a visible backup service when main transport stops for the night.

berlin/berlin-blockade-video.keyIdea: Blocking land and water access to western Berlin forced the city to rely on supplies brought by air.
berlin/berlin-blockade-video.tradeoff: A city loses normal supply routes when another authority can close its access.
berlin/berlin-blockade-video.designUse: Plan alternative supply routes if roads or waterways become unavailable.

berlin/museum-island.keyIdea: Berlin's Museum Island groups collections in nearby buildings, making one small area a shared place for understanding the past.
berlin/museum-island.tradeoff: Museum choices give some histories and explanations more attention than others.
berlin/museum-island.designUse: Link nearby collections while making their different histories and ownership visible.

berlin/tempelhofer-feld.keyIdea: Berlin's former airport now gives people a large field for cycling, gardening, games, and meeting friends.
berlin/tempelhofer-feld.tradeoff: Keeping the field open leaves less land available for housing.
berlin/tempelhofer-feld.designUse: Compare shared open-space needs with housing needs before reusing large sites.

berlin/memory-language.keyIdea: Berlin's memorials use different forms to make people pause and think about loss, responsibility, and public memory.
berlin/memory-language.tradeoff: Choosing which stories receive protection can leave others with less public attention.
berlin/memory-language.designUse: Create places for reflection that acknowledge more than one experience of history.

moscow/city-history-video.keyIdea: Some Moscow City tower plans changed or remained unbuilt when practical features proved difficult to deliver.
moscow/city-history-video.tradeoff: Striking shapes can require equipment or upkeep that designers have not solved.
moscow/city-history-video.designUse: Check equipment and winter upkeep before committing to unusual building shapes.

moscow/metro-video.keyIdea: Moscow's decorated metro stations use architecture to communicate state power during an ordinary daily journey.
moscow/metro-video.tradeoff: The grand scale can make a passenger feel small beneath the state.
moscow/metro-video.designUse: Consider what station decoration tells passengers about who the space serves.

moscow/kremlin-red-square-video.keyIdea: Moscow's Kremlin churches show how religious places can become closely connected with government and national public life.
moscow/kremlin-red-square-video.tradeoff: Changes in government can lead to religious suppression and the destruction of sacred places.
moscow/kremlin-red-square-video.designUse: Protect sacred places while explaining changing relations between religion and government.

moscow/river-capital.keyIdea: The Moscow River shaped the city's location and still guides bridges, parks, and routes through the modern capital.
moscow/river-capital.tradeoff: Modern transport does not remove the need to plan around the river.
moscow/river-capital.designUse: Use a river's course to connect bridges, green edges, and city routes.

moscow/winter-public-life.keyIdea: Moscow's public places need different lighting, surfaces, shelter, and activities when winter brings cold, ice, and darkness.
moscow/winter-public-life.tradeoff: Snow and ice can limit movement even when outdoor spaces work well in summer.
moscow/winter-public-life.designUse: Test public spaces for safe movement in both warm and cold seasons.

moscow/literary-city.keyIdea: Moscow's libraries, theatres, bookshops, and street names can make learning about writers part of life beyond a classroom.
moscow/literary-city.tradeoff: Public choices about writers and books can make some histories less visible.
moscow/literary-city.designUse: Place opportunities to read and learn about writers along everyday routes.

istanbul/constantinople-istanbul-video.keyIdea: Istanbul's popular name gained official use through rules that encouraged other countries to adopt it.
istanbul/constantinople-istanbul-video.tradeoff: Other countries kept using the older name, slowing acceptance of the change.
istanbul/constantinople-istanbul-video.designUse: Use official names consistently on maps, notices, and public services.

istanbul/mosques-architecture-video.keyIdea: Istanbul's Suleymaniye Mosque uses a wide shared interior and many windows to express religious unity through space and light.
istanbul/mosques-architecture-video.tradeoff: Its apparently light interior depends on very large structural supports.
istanbul/mosques-architecture-video.designUse: Make structural support serve an interior's shared purpose and atmosphere.

istanbul/two-continents-video.keyIdea: Istanbul's waterway places European and Asian neighborhoods within one city, bringing different histories into the same urban setting.
istanbul/two-continents-video.tradeoff: Living across water means movement must bridge the city's divided geography.
istanbul/two-continents-video.designUse: Plan crossings that treat both sides of a waterway as one city.

istanbul/grand-bazaar-language.keyIdea: Istanbul's Grand Bazaar uses conversation about goods, stories, and prices to build relationships before a sale is agreed.
istanbul/grand-bazaar-language.tradeoff: Competition and changing demand can shift risk onto workers and small sellers.
istanbul/grand-bazaar-language.designUse: Allow time for product stories and friendly questions before negotiating a price.

istanbul/ferry-city.keyIdea: Istanbul's ferries make crossing the Bosphorus an ordinary commute as well as a journey through the city's landscape.
istanbul/ferry-city.tradeoff: A fast ferry is less useful if connections or final access are poor.
istanbul/ferry-city.designUse: Link ferry stops with clear onward routes to people's actual destinations.

istanbul/earthquake-readiness.keyIdea: Istanbul's earthquake planning must connect strong buildings, emergency routes, family plans, and services in a dense historic city.
istanbul/earthquake-readiness.tradeoff: Older buildings and dense streets make preparation more difficult across different neighborhoods.
istanbul/earthquake-readiness.designUse: Prepare historic districts through building checks, local instructions, and usable rescue routes.

vancouver/underground-streams-video.keyIdea: Vancouver buried streams to make building space, but pipes and shared sewers now struggle with heavy rain.
vancouver/underground-streams-video.tradeoff: Restoring streams can mean removing roads or buildings already above them.
vancouver/underground-streams-video.designUse: Let rain soak into living stream corridors instead of overloaded shared pipes.

vancouver/skytrain-video.keyIdea: Vancouver's SkyTrain connects homes, colleges, and the airport, while a reloadable card helps passengers move through station gates.
vancouver/skytrain-video.tradeoff: The trains do not run all night, so late travelers need another way home.
vancouver/skytrain-video.designUse: Show last departures and backup journeys alongside normal rail directions.

vancouver/city-in-nature-video.keyIdea: Vancouver's nearby beaches, forests, and mountains let visitors move between city activities and nature in a short trip.
vancouver/city-in-nature-video.tradeoff: Wildlife appears on its own schedule, not when a visitor expects it.
vancouver/city-in-nature-video.designUse: Keep urban outings linked to nearby natural places without promising wildlife sightings.

vancouver/host-nations.keyIdea: Vancouver's Indigenous place names can make older knowledge and continuing relationships visible again on signs and maps.
vancouver/host-nations.tradeoff: Acknowledgment alone does not address unequal power or teach present-day priorities.
vancouver/host-nations.designUse: Restore local names with explanations shaped by the Nations connected to them.

vancouver/seawall-routine.keyIdea: Vancouver's seawall combines shoreline protection and public access, separating walkers from faster users in busy sections.
vancouver/seawall-routine.tradeoff: Storms, erosion, and heavy use create continuing repair needs along the waterfront.
vancouver/seawall-routine.designUse: Separate walking and cycling flows along a publicly accessible protective shoreline.

vancouver/housing-pressure.keyIdea: Vancouver's limited land and strong housing demand raise prices, pushing some residents farther from work and community.
vancouver/housing-pressure.tradeoff: More construction costs time and money and may still produce unaffordable homes.
vancouver/housing-pressure.designUse: Add homes near services while protecting existing renters from displacement.

toronto/growth-video.keyIdea: Toronto's Union Station brought several railway companies together, linking city travel with a nearby hotel built for passengers.
toronto/growth-video.tradeoff: Disagreements between railway partners and material shortages delayed the new station.
toronto/growth-video.designUse: Agree shared decisions between transport partners before building a joint terminal.

toronto/public-transit-video.keyIdea: A Toronto visitor uses subway trains and streetcars together, but an unclear route makes a simple journey take longer.
toronto/public-transit-video.tradeoff: Without maps or instructions, unfamiliar passengers can get lost between transfers.
toronto/public-transit-video.designUse: Put useful street maps and transfer instructions where passengers leave stations.

toronto/multicultural-video.keyIdea: Toronto's football gatherings let people share city life while keeping ties to more than one national background.
toronto/multicultural-video.tradeoff: A single national team does not capture every fan's inherited connection.
toronto/multicultural-video.designUse: Create shared sports gatherings where people can support different teams together.

toronto/ravine-city.keyIdea: Toronto's ravines bring green routes through the city, carrying rainwater and giving people access to plants and animals.
toronto/ravine-city.tradeoff: Erosion, invasive species, trash, and development can damage these shared natural corridors.
toronto/ravine-city.designUse: Protect green drainage routes from building pressure and damaging everyday use.

toronto/neighborhood-arrival.keyIdea: Toronto's shops, languages, schools, and festivals show how newcomers adapt inherited culture while building neighborhood life.
toronto/neighborhood-arrival.tradeoff: Public attention can reduce complex arrival experiences to a marketable cultural image.
toronto/neighborhood-arrival.designUse: Let newcomers explain their experiences through neighborhood events and everyday services.

toronto/waterfront-rebuild.keyIdea: Toronto's waterfront redevelopment can combine new housing, parks, transit, and flood protection on former industrial land.
toronto/waterfront-rebuild.tradeoff: New neighborhoods can become too expensive or leave people with weak public access.
toronto/waterfront-rebuild.designUse: Combine flood protection and new homes with affordable, open shoreline access.

mumbai/city-history-video.keyIdea: Mumbai grew as artisans and merchants moved to its port, strengthening trade and links with the mainland.
mumbai/city-history-video.tradeoff: Conflict helped drive people toward the island rather than letting everyone choose freely.
mumbai/city-history-video.designUse: Plan port growth around incoming workers and the connections they need.

mumbai/dabbawalas-video.keyIdea: Mumbai's lunch deliverers use simple codes and coordinated bicycle and train stages to move meals and return empty boxes.
mumbai/dabbawalas-video.tradeoff: Each stage depends on workers cooperating within a tight daily timetable.
mumbai/dabbawalas-video.designUse: Code reusable containers clearly and coordinate handovers across several delivery stages.

mumbai/street-food-video.keyIdea: Mumbai's food stalls offer versions of familiar dishes across different neighborhoods, turning everyday snacks into local visitor experiences.
mumbai/street-food-video.tradeoff: The short tour says little about the workers behind the dishes.
mumbai/street-food-video.designUse: Introduce familiar foods through neighborhood stalls and the people who make them.

mumbai/monsoon-city.keyIdea: Mumbai's rainy season changes train travel, school days, repairs, and routines, making weather part of everyday planning.
mumbai/monsoon-city.tradeoff: Rain disrupts journeys and affects drainage, housing, waste, and public health.
mumbai/monsoon-city.designUse: Prepare travel advice and maintenance work around predictable seasonal rain.

mumbai/dharavi-enterprise.keyIdea: Mumbai's Dharavi combines small industries, recycling, food production, and family life, which a poverty-only image hides.
mumbai/dharavi-enterprise.tradeoff: Outside attention can simplify residents' work and reduce their control over its story.
mumbai/dharavi-enterprise.designUse: Ask residents about local skills and needs before presenting a neighborhood.

mumbai/art-deco-gothic.keyIdea: Mumbai's neighboring Gothic and Art Deco buildings make changing ideas about style and city building visible in one area.
mumbai/art-deco-gothic.tradeoff: Building style alone does not explain all the choices or costs behind it.
mumbai/art-deco-gothic.designUse: Use contrasting building styles to discuss the needs each period prioritized.

cape-town/founded-video.keyIdea: Cape Town's segregation laws controlled where people could live, work, and learn, shaping inequality across the city.
cape-town/founded-video.tradeoff: Changing laws does not quickly undo generations of forced separation and lost opportunity.
cape-town/founded-video.designUse: Check that housing and service rules do not exclude groups of residents.

cape-town/table-mountain-video.keyIdea: Cape Town's mountain cable car gives visitors access to high views, with website updates helping them plan around conditions.
cape-town/table-mountain-video.tradeoff: High winds can close the service, and uneven paths need careful footwear.
cape-town/table-mountain-video.designUse: Publish live access conditions before visitors set out for exposed natural places.

cape-town/water-crisis-video.keyIdea: Cape Town's water crisis pushed residents to reduce use and reuse shower water, alongside discussion of new supply systems.
cape-town/water-crisis-video.tradeoff: Households have different needs, and some had poor water access before the crisis.
cape-town/water-crisis-video.designUse: Set saving rules that consider care needs and existing gaps in access.

cape-town/district-six-memory.keyIdea: Cape Town's District Six shows how forced removal broke a mixed neighborhood's connections between homes, shops, schools, and memories.
cape-town/district-six-memory.tradeoff: Clearing an area destroys relationships as well as the buildings people occupy.
cape-town/district-six-memory.designUse: Record residents' connected lives before judging a neighborhood only by its buildings.

cape-town/robben-island.keyIdea: Robben Island near Cape Town links a place of imprisonment with continuing questions about resistance, memory, and democracy.
cape-town/robben-island.tradeoff: Focusing on one famous prisoner can hide other people's experiences there.
cape-town/robben-island.designUse: Tell shared places of memory through several people's experiences of resistance.

cape-town/fynbos-biodiversity.keyIdea: Cape Town's nearby fynbos makes city planning a question about plant diversity, housing pressure, water, and conservation.
cape-town/fynbos-biodiversity.tradeoff: Fire, invasive plants, and development create competing demands on the same natural setting.
cape-town/fynbos-biodiversity.designUse: Include native plant habitats when deciding where housing and recreation should go.

rome/ancient-rome-video.keyIdea: Ancient Rome's roads, first built for military movement, also carried people and ideas across the expanding empire.
rome/ancient-rome-video.tradeoff: The network's growth was tied to conquest and domination of other peoples.
rome/ancient-rome-video.designUse: Make transport links useful for everyday exchange as well as their original purpose.

rome/colosseum-video.keyIdea: Rome's Colosseum used numbered entrances and seating levels to direct crowds while separating spectators by social status.
rome/colosseum-video.tradeoff: The best seats were reserved for elites, leaving lower-status people farther away.
rome/colosseum-video.designUse: Number entrances clearly without assigning access according to social status.

rome/food-market-video.keyIdea: Rome's covered market brings specialist food sellers together, letting local buyers learn about fresh products directly from them.
rome/food-market-video.tradeoff: Some fresh foods need careful storage and quick eating to retain their quality.
rome/food-market-video.designUse: Give specialist sellers space to explain freshness and preparation to buyers.

rome/aqueduct-thinking.keyIdea: Rome's aqueducts brought water into a dense city, supporting baths, fountains, homes, and shared public life.
rome/aqueduct-thinking.tradeoff: Useful water infrastructure still depends on maintenance and decisions about access.
rome/aqueduct-thinking.designUse: Plan water supply around several shared uses rather than one destination.

rome/piazza-life.keyIdea: Rome's piazzas use surrounding buildings, shade, steps, and seats to make outdoor spaces where people can stay together.
rome/piazza-life.tradeoff: An attractive square is less useful without shade or reasons to remain.
rome/piazza-life.designUse: Shape squares with comfortable edges, sitting places, and activities that invite staying.

rome/layers-underfoot.keyIdea: Rome's ancient remains appear beneath modern streets and building sites, placing history inside decisions about new infrastructure.
rome/layers-underfoot.tradeoff: Building homes and utilities can conflict with protecting the ancient layers below.
rome/layers-underfoot.designUse: Check underground heritage before choosing routes for new utilities and transport.

rio-de-janeiro/city-history-video.keyIdea: Rio's protected bay supported port trade, while nearby mineral discoveries helped the city grow into a center of government.
rio-de-janeiro/city-history-video.tradeoff: The benefits of city growth sit beside large differences in wealth.
rio-de-janeiro/city-history-video.designUse: Link port investment with opportunities for neighborhoods across different income levels.

rio-de-janeiro/favela-history-video.keyIdea: Rio's housing clearances pushed poorer residents towards hillside settlements when replacement homes were not provided.
rio-de-janeiro/favela-history-video.tradeoff: Removing old housing can displace people if no alternative homes are ready.
rio-de-janeiro/favela-history-video.designUse: Provide replacement homes before removing housing that people already rely on.

rio-de-janeiro/carnival-video.keyIdea: Rio's Carnival brings African-influenced music, costumes, and dance into a shared celebration prepared by community samba groups.
rio-de-janeiro/carnival-video.tradeoff: Large parades require months of preparation before the public celebration.
rio-de-janeiro/carnival-video.designUse: Give community festivals time to develop themes, costumes, and performances together.

rio-de-janeiro/tijuca-forest.keyIdea: Replanting damaged parts of Rio's Tijuca Forest shows how restoration can support water, shade, wildlife, and city identity.
rio-de-janeiro/tijuca-forest.tradeoff: A restored forest still needs care alongside pressure from city use.
rio-de-janeiro/tijuca-forest.designUse: Restore damaged green areas for water, shade, and wildlife as well as views.

rio-de-janeiro/beach-public-life.keyIdea: Rio's beaches combine swimming, work, exercise, music, and meeting friends in a shared natural public space.
rio-de-janeiro/beach-public-life.tradeoff: Differences in money, safety, and status can affect who enjoys that space.
rio-de-janeiro/beach-public-life.designUse: Leave beach space for several everyday activities with fair access and safety.

rio-de-janeiro/samba-schools.keyIdea: Rio's samba parades depend on designers, welders, musicians, families, and organizers working together long before the performance.
rio-de-janeiro/samba-schools.tradeoff: The visible parade can hide the many workers and resources behind it.
rio-de-janeiro/samba-schools.designUse: Divide festival work across creative and practical teams, recognizing each contribution.

mexico-city/complex-history-video.keyIdea: Mexico City's Spanish buildings stand above earlier Aztec places, letting guides show different histories within the same streets.
mexico-city/complex-history-video.tradeoff: Only a small part of the older city has been uncovered.
mexico-city/complex-history-video.designUse: Use guides and visible remains to explain what lies below modern streets.

mexico-city/metro-tips-video.keyIdea: Mexico City's metro connects major arrival points, but passengers need to watch station names and prepare quickly to leave.
mexico-city/metro-tips-video.tradeoff: Crowded carriages and brief stops make travel with large bags difficult.
mexico-city/metro-tips-video.designUse: Place stop information where standing passengers can see it before exits open.

mexico-city/street-food-video.keyIdea: Mexico City's street food brings ingredients and snacks from different traditions into small stands across its neighborhoods.
mexico-city/street-food-video.tradeoff: Reaching scattered stalls means spending time traveling across a large city.
mexico-city/street-food-video.designUse: Group neighborhood food routes by short walks rather than scattered highlights.

mexico-city/xochimilco-chinampas.keyIdea: Mexico City's chinampas combine raised fields and canals, keeping an older food-growing system active within the city.
mexico-city/xochimilco-chinampas.tradeoff: Fields and canals need ongoing water care, not just attention from visitors.
mexico-city/xochimilco-chinampas.designUse: Keep heritage farming systems working through protected fields and maintained water routes.

mexico-city/sinking-city.keyIdea: Removing groundwater beneath Mexico City compacts soft soils, causing sinking that affects streets, buildings, and water pipes.
mexico-city/sinking-city.tradeoff: Getting water from below can damage the ground supporting essential city systems.
mexico-city/sinking-city.designUse: Check how water extraction changes ground stability before planning new infrastructure.

mexico-city/markets-and-memory.keyIdea: Mexico City's markets build repeated relationships, as sellers recognize families and connect regional ingredients with everyday routines.
mexico-city/markets-and-memory.tradeoff: Protecting one version of market memory can leave other community stories less visible.
mexico-city/markets-and-memory.designUse: Keep familiar sellers involved when documenting how families use a market.

buenos-aires/city-history-video.keyIdea: Buenos Aires' surrounding grasslands supported cattle and leather trade, helping commerce grow as the city became a capital.
buenos-aires/city-history-video.tradeoff: Trade restrictions also encouraged smuggling rather than bringing all business under official rules.
buenos-aires/city-history-video.designUse: Set trade rules that account for existing goods and local livelihoods.

buenos-aires/tango-video.keyIdea: Tango's shared dance floor works through small steps, one direction, and enough space between people moving together.
buenos-aires/tango-video.tradeoff: Large backward steps risk hitting someone dancing close behind you.
buenos-aires/tango-video.designUse: Keep shared movement spaces predictable through direction, spacing, and small steps.

buenos-aires/landmarks-video.keyIdea: Buenos Aires uses the plaza around its Obelisk for cultural events, public messages, and shared football celebrations.
buenos-aires/landmarks-video.tradeoff: Landmarks spread across the city can be difficult to fit into one visit.
buenos-aires/landmarks-video.designUse: Let a landmark's surrounding space serve community events as well as viewing.

buenos-aires/notable-bars.keyIdea: Buenos Aires' cafes and notable bars turn repeated conversation, reading, and meeting into part of the city's cultural life.
buenos-aires/notable-bars.tradeoff: A famous image can simplify the ordinary routines that give a place meaning.
buenos-aires/notable-bars.designUse: Protect time and space for ordinary conversation in valued social venues.

buenos-aires/book-city.keyIdea: Buenos Aires' bookshops can serve as meeting places and quiet interiors, bringing reading into everyday city life.
buenos-aires/book-city.tradeoff: Choices about cultural visibility can leave some writers and histories less represented.
buenos-aires/book-city.designUse: Combine book selling with places to meet, browse, and read quietly.

buenos-aires/la-boca-color.keyIdea: Buenos Aires' La Boca carries port and migration histories beyond the colorful tourist image of tango and football.
buenos-aires/la-boca-color.tradeoff: Visitor attention can turn residents' complex lives into a simple performance.
buenos-aires/la-boca-color.designUse: Present a colorful district through resident stories, work, and migration history.

los-angeles/hollywood-history-video.keyIdea: Los Angeles attracted film production through suitable weather, varied nearby settings, and land that studios could afford.
los-angeles/hollywood-history-video.tradeoff: A concentrated studio industry can control production, distribution, and where films are shown.
los-angeles/hollywood-history-video.designUse: Locate creative workplaces near useful settings while checking who controls distribution.

los-angeles/metro-rail-video.keyIdea: Los Angeles' Metro combines payment tools, transfer rules, platform advice, and visible staff to help people use rail safely.
los-angeles/metro-rail-video.tradeoff: Passengers unfamiliar with gates or validators must learn the payment steps before boarding.
los-angeles/metro-rail-video.designUse: Explain payment and safety steps at the places where passengers perform them.

los-angeles/smog-history-video.keyIdea: Sunlight reacts with fuel-related chemicals in Los Angeles' air, producing smog that damages plants and helps explain pollution.
los-angeles/smog-history-video.tradeoff: The harmful pollution is formed through interactions, not simply emitted as one substance.
los-angeles/smog-history-video.designUse: Study local air reactions before choosing which pollution sources to control.

los-angeles/water-imports.keyIdea: Los Angeles' dry setting makes imported water, groundwater, saving, and recycling part of decisions about growth and daily habits.
los-angeles/water-imports.tradeoff: Drought limits supply while different users carry different water costs and risks.
los-angeles/water-imports.designUse: Connect growth plans with realistic water sources and responsible household use.

los-angeles/freeway-language.keyIdea: Los Angeles' freeways connect jobs and neighborhoods but also shape a city where car ownership can feel necessary.
los-angeles/freeway-language.tradeoff: Roads can divide communities and increase pollution while shortening some journeys.
los-angeles/freeway-language.designUse: Compare faster driving routes with their effects on nearby community connections.

los-angeles/murals-and-neighborhoods.keyIdea: Los Angeles' murals put memory, protest, and local pride on walls that people pass in daily life.
los-angeles/murals-and-neighborhoods.tradeoff: Public artwork can be contested because people interpret neighborhood identity differently.
los-angeles/murals-and-neighborhoods.designUse: Invite neighborhood voices to shape art on walls used in everyday routes.

jakarta/historical-places-video.keyIdea: Jakarta's old town reuses colonial buildings as museums, cafes, and galleries, making earlier city layers visible through new uses.
jakarta/historical-places-video.tradeoff: Visitor uses may show only part of the area's wider history.
jakarta/historical-places-video.designUse: Keep reused historic buildings connected to explanations of their earlier roles.

jakarta/flood-control-video.keyIdea: Jakarta uses pumps and canals to manage floodwater, but concrete surfaces and blocked river connections limit their effect.
jakarta/flood-control-video.tradeoff: Widening rivers or linking canals can require relocation that residents dispute.
jakarta/flood-control-video.designUse: Combine flood equipment with absorbent ground and fair agreements on needed land.

jakarta/transport-video.keyIdea: Jakarta's rail expansion offers commuters a way around road congestion and aims to reach more of the wider urban region.
jakarta/transport-video.tradeoff: New mass transport is costly, and many journeys still depend on roads.
jakarta/transport-video.designUse: Expand rail toward commuters outside the center while planning its funding.

jakarta/old-batavia.keyIdea: Jakarta's older port buildings and street names carry traces of trade and power through the fast-changing city.
jakarta/old-batavia.tradeoff: Choosing which traces to keep gives some histories more visibility than others.
jakarta/old-batavia.designUse: Explain older trade routes through warehouse sites, street names, and local accounts.

jakarta/new-capital-question.keyIdea: Indonesia's proposed new capital responds to pressures on Jakarta by moving some government functions away from the city.
jakarta/new-capital-question.tradeoff: Relocation costs money and raises new environmental questions elsewhere.
jakarta/new-capital-question.designUse: Compare relocating public offices with improving services in the existing capital.

jakarta/warung-life.keyIdea: Jakarta's small warung stalls offer food, quick services, and familiar conversation near people's homes or workplaces.
jakarta/warung-life.tradeoff: Their usefulness depends on keeping daily services close to the people needing them.
jakarta/warung-life.designUse: Keep small everyday service stalls within reach of homes and workplaces.

lagos/local-city-video.keyIdea: Lagos' Lekki Conservation Center offers canopy walks and wildlife within the busy city, giving people a nearby natural escape.
lagos/local-city-video.tradeoff: Traffic can make reaching places for leisure stressful even within the city.
lagos/local-city-video.designUse: Connect crowded urban areas with accessible places for nature and quiet.

lagos/mass-transit-video.keyIdea: Lagos commuters use boats to avoid slow roads, while transport plans aim to connect water, road, and rail services.
lagos/mass-transit-video.tradeoff: Funding and implementation problems can prevent a transport plan from working.
lagos/mass-transit-video.designUse: Combine faster water journeys with road and rail connections in one plan.

lagos/market-video.keyIdea: Lagos' Lekki Market gives craftspeople places to sell goods, while residents and visitors meet local art and traditions.
lagos/market-video.tradeoff: Sellers need suitable materials and paying customers to keep their work going.
lagos/market-video.designUse: Link craft selling with chances for customers to understand materials and makers.

lagos/lagoon-transport.keyIdea: Lagos' lagoon geography makes useful movement depend on links between islands, mainland roads, bridges, and water routes.
lagos/lagoon-transport.tradeoff: Slow or costly connections can keep residents away from work and education.
lagos/lagoon-transport.designUse: Map complete journeys across water and land rather than separate vehicle routes.

lagos/nollywood-city.keyIdea: Lagos' film production depends on writers, editors, drivers, and other workers as well as the stars audiences recognize.
lagos/nollywood-city.tradeoff: Workers face risks when audience demand, costs, or technology change quickly.
lagos/nollywood-city.designUse: Include support workers and distribution needs when planning a local creative industry.

lagos/market-enterprise.keyIdea: Lagos' market sellers use knowledge of goods and customers to organize busy trading spaces and build livelihoods.
lagos/market-enterprise.tradeoff: Crowding and noise can make it harder for unfamiliar buyers to communicate.
lagos/market-enterprise.designUse: Make price and quality discussions understandable even in crowded trading areas.

hong-kong/animated-history-video.keyIdea: Hong Kong shifted towards manufacturing and financial services when restrictions reduced its older trade links with mainland China.
hong-kong/animated-history-video.tradeoff: Growth also brought inequality and very crowded living conditions for poorer residents.
hong-kong/animated-history-video.designUse: Develop alternative industries while checking whether incoming workers can find decent homes.

hong-kong/transport-system-video.keyIdea: Hong Kong's MTR earns from buildings and shops around stations, using that income to maintain and expand railways.
hong-kong/transport-system-video.tradeoff: The model relies on suitable property around stations and businesses attracting customers.
hong-kong/transport-system-video.designUse: Fund rail improvements through the value created around well-connected stations.

hong-kong/housing-video.keyIdea: Hong Kong's proposed minimum housing standards aim to improve tiny rooms, but tenants worry about losing affordable places.
hong-kong/housing-video.tradeoff: Upgrades can increase rents or displace residents without protection and replacement housing.
hong-kong/housing-video.designUse: Pair minimum housing standards with tenant protection and affordable alternatives.

hong-kong/country-parks.keyIdea: Hong Kong's protected country parks keep hills, beaches, and trails close to people living in dense neighborhoods.
hong-kong/country-parks.tradeoff: Protecting natural areas requires continuing care alongside pressure from city use.
hong-kong/country-parks.designUse: Keep protected trails and green areas connected to dense residential districts.

hong-kong/harbour-reclamation.keyIdea: Hong Kong adds land around its harbour to make space for roads, homes, offices, and public places.
hong-kong/harbour-reclamation.tradeoff: More land reduces water area and can change views people value.
hong-kong/harbour-reclamation.designUse: Compare new land uses with the water space and views they replace.

hong-kong/cha-chaan-teng.keyIdea: Hong Kong's cha chaan teng cafes mix different food influences with quick service that fits busy city routines.
hong-kong/cha-chaan-teng.tradeoff: A marketable food image can simplify the history behind an ordinary meal.
hong-kong/cha-chaan-teng.designUse: Offer quick everyday meals that keep mixed local food traditions visible.

amsterdam/city-history-video.keyIdea: Amsterdam's early settlers used dikes and a river dam to make a flood-prone place suitable for a growing settlement.
amsterdam/city-history-video.tradeoff: Building in a wet setting creates an ongoing need to manage water.
amsterdam/city-history-video.designUse: Make water control part of a settlement's first layout, not a later addition.

amsterdam/cycling-video.keyIdea: Amsterdam reduced parking and closed some streets to cars, giving walking and cycling priority after pressure over road deaths.
amsterdam/cycling-video.tradeoff: Better conditions for bikes deliberately make some journeys less convenient for drivers.
amsterdam/cycling-video.designUse: Use slower shared streets and car limits to make cycling practical.

amsterdam/canals-video.keyIdea: Amsterdam uses boats with special cranes to clear canal debris, maintaining waterways that also carry boats and floating homes.
amsterdam/canals-video.tradeoff: Objects dropped into canals create repeated cleaning work for the city.
amsterdam/canals-video.designUse: Include access for cleaning equipment when designing active urban waterways.

amsterdam/canal-ring-planning.keyIdea: Amsterdam's canal ring joined trade, drainage, housing, and movement in one planned system that still shapes city life.
amsterdam/canal-ring-planning.tradeoff: Old layouts must keep serving new users while important historic features remain.
amsterdam/canal-ring-planning.designUse: Combine several city functions when planning a durable water-based street layout.

amsterdam/water-management.keyIdea: Amsterdam combines canals, pumps, dikes, and local water management to keep places safe for living, travel, and building.
amsterdam/water-management.tradeoff: Structures need upkeep and public cooperation, even when their work is hard to notice.
amsterdam/water-management.designUse: Keep water-control equipment supported by maintenance routines and local knowledge.

amsterdam/museum-choices.keyIdea: Amsterdam's museum displays shape which histories people see, including the trade and money that made art possible.
amsterdam/museum-choices.tradeoff: Focusing only on beauty can hide where objects came from and who paid.
amsterdam/museum-choices.designUse: Show objects' origins and funding alongside their appearance and artistic qualities.

honolulu/hula-story-video.keyIdea: Hawaiian hula keeps stories alive through dancers who learn to move together and share responsibility for the tradition.
honolulu/hula-story-video.tradeoff: Treating the dance only as a hobby can hide its cultural responsibility.
honolulu/hula-story-video.designUse: Teach shared performance as a responsibility to stories, not only entertainment.

honolulu/spam-musubi-video.keyIdea: Hawaiian musubi makers combine Japanese rice-snack traditions with local fillings, creating portable food that fits everyday demand.
honolulu/spam-musubi-video.tradeoff: Customers from different backgrounds may expect different fillings and portion sizes.
honolulu/spam-musubi-video.designUse: Adapt a portable food format while explaining different local versions.

honolulu/city-history-video.keyIdea: Honolulu's sheltered harbour brought ships, goods, and ideas, helping the city grow as an important Pacific stopping place.
honolulu/city-history-video.tradeoff: Trade and plantation wealth also came with exploitation and pressure on local people.
honolulu/city-history-video.designUse: Assess port growth through workers' lives and local relationships as well as trade.

honolulu/ahupuaa-land-and-water.keyIdea: Honolulu's older ahupuaa framework links upland forests, streams, farms, and coastal waters through the movement of water downhill.
honolulu/ahupuaa-land-and-water.tradeoff: Treating each property separately can miss effects reaching streams and reefs below.
honolulu/ahupuaa-land-and-water.designUse: Plan from ridge to reef so upstream choices protect downstream places.

honolulu/waikiki-changing-coast.keyIdea: Honolulu's Waikiki beach combines altered waterways, buildings, and added sand, making its famous coast both natural and maintained.
honolulu/waikiki-changing-coast.tradeoff: Protecting buildings can restrict sand movement, while replacing sand requires repeated spending.
honolulu/waikiki-changing-coast.designUse: Leave room for coastal movement when balancing beach use and nearby buildings.

honolulu/pearl-harbor-memory.keyIdea: Honolulu's Pearl Harbor uses preserved ships, names, and quiet spaces to connect a working harbour with memory of war.
honolulu/pearl-harbor-memory.tradeoff: The arrangement of memorials shapes which experiences of the conflict receive most attention.
honolulu/pearl-harbor-memory.designUse: Arrange working historic sites with quiet places and varied personal accounts.

miami/little-havana-video.keyIdea: Miami's Little Havana coffee windows give different generations places to exchange news, debate politics, and maintain Cuban community ties.
miami/little-havana-video.tradeoff: Strong community symbols may not capture every generation's different experience.
miami/little-havana-video.designUse: Create small meeting points where familiar food supports everyday community conversation.

miami/everglades-video.keyIdea: South Florida's Everglades carry rainwater, support wildlife, and refill underground drinking-water supplies used by communities around Miami.
miami/everglades-video.tradeoff: Development and changed water flows can dry wetlands and threaten both wildlife and water supply.
miami/everglades-video.designUse: Restore wetland water flows as part of drinking-water and flood planning.

miami/rapid-transit-video.keyIdea: Miami's express-bus plan combines dedicated lanes and sheltered, cooled stops to make journeys easier in heavy traffic and heat.
miami/rapid-transit-video.tradeoff: Rail was considered too costly for existing passenger demand in the corridor.
miami/rapid-transit-video.designUse: Choose expandable transit stops that address heat while serving current passenger demand.

miami/art-deco-preservation.keyIdea: Miami Beach protected older Art Deco hotels as a shared collection, turning threatened buildings into a recognizable neighborhood identity.
miami/art-deco-preservation.tradeoff: Restoration attracts new uses and audiences, so preservation still changes the area.
miami/art-deco-preservation.designUse: Retain characteristic building features while updating systems for practical modern uses.

miami/rising-water.keyIdea: Miami's porous ground lets floodwater move beneath barriers, so protection must combine drainage, raised roads, and other measures.
miami/rising-water.tradeoff: Raised streets can redirect water, while pumps require power and upkeep.
miami/rising-water.designUse: Match flood defenses to ground conditions and check where displaced water goes.

miami/languages-of-arrival.keyIdea: Miami's speakers choose languages for family, work, and public life, connecting neighborhoods with several places and cultures.
miami/languages-of-arrival.tradeoff: Language ability can still limit access to jobs and public services.
miami/languages-of-arrival.designUse: Provide language choices that reflect real users of local offices and businesses.
